extracted.intended_audience: LMS members, mathematicians, university departments, and potential contributors/advertisers
extracted.subtask_description: Information page describing the London Mathematical Society Newsletter: its aims, publication schedule, distribution, and what types of contributions are welcomed (mathematical articles, career pieces, microtheses); includes links for submission and advertising.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim of the LMS Newsletter
rubrics_metrics.description: The LMS Newsletter aims to provide a sense of identity, community, and connection for members. It communicates the power, beauty and value of mathematics and mathematical research by disseminating new mathematical ideas and information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should support community identity and convey the value, beauty and power of mathematics and mathematical research. Pieces that disseminate new mathematical ideas and information are aligned with the Newsletter's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication frequency and format
rubrics_metrics.description: The LMS Newsletter is published four times a year, in February, May, September and December.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issues are produced quarterly; a PDF of the latest issue is made available and print copies are distributed to LMS members and to universities around the UK.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted content types / submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome submissions of feature content, including mathematical articles, career-related articles, and microtheses, from members and non-members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are open to both members and non-members and should fall into accepted categories (mathematical articles, career pieces, microtheses). The page links to further 'how to submit' instructions for formatting, length, deadlines, and contact details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising in the Newsletter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is an advertising route; the page links to further information about advertising opportunities, likely including specs, deadlines, and rates (details on the linked 'find out more about advertising' page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial oversight and back issues access
rubrics_metrics.description: An Editorial Board and staff team manage the Newsletter; electronic copies of all previous issues are free to access online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meet the Editorial Board and staff for editorial policies and contact points. Back issues are freely available online for reference, which can inform style, scope, and typical content.
